decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids as the main win condition to cheat out powerful creatures from the deck. The deck includes a variety of control spells and disruptive elements to protect the Oath plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Oko, Thief of Crowns to control the board and generate card advantage. The deck aims to control the game early on and then overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures with disruptive abilities to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. The deck focuses on playing hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down the opponent, while also utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Seasoned Dungeoneer to generate card advantage and create threats. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator and mana acceleration cards like Ancient Tomb and Moxen help increase the deck's overall efficiency and allow for explosive starts.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's strategies while maintaining card advantage and resource efficiency. It utilizes powerful mana acceleration like Moxen and powerful card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through countermagic and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, while also setting up powerful win conditions like Time Vault combo or Bolas's Citadel. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the game. It aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent until it can secure a victory.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the graveyard as a resource to quickly and efficiently bring out powerful creatures like Hollow One, Ichorid, and Prized Amalgam. By using cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Stinkweed Imp, and Shambling Shell to dredge through the deck, the player can fill the graveyard with creatures and trigger abilities that allow for explosive combos. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void to protect its strategy and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of using Doomsday to stack cards in a specific order to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. It utilizes powerful draw spells such as Gitaxian Probe, Brainstorm, and Demonic Tutor to quickly find key pieces. Control elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm protect the combo, while cards like Gush and Necropotence provide additional card advantage. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Negation and Daze to protect against opposing threats. The goal is to efficiently set up the Doomsday win condition while disrupting opponents' game plans.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control and combo pieces to disrupt opponents while assembling a lethal win condition. It includes key cards like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel to generate advantage and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Opposition Agent and Hullbreacher adds another layer of control to the deck. With a strong suite of counterspells and tutors, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and establish dominance through efficient card advantage and strategic plays.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Anointed Peacekeeper. The deck also utilizes powerful mana acceleration in the form of Ancient Tomb, City of Traitors, and Moxen to quickly deploy threats and lock down the opponent's spells with cards like Trinisphere. The overall strategy is to control the game through disruptive creatures and mana denial while beating down the opponent efficiently.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through manipulation of the opponent's resources and spells while setting up powerful win conditions. This is achieved through a combination of counter spells, card draw, tutoring for key cards, and utilizing artifacts like Urza's Saga and Manifold Key to create advantages. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Urza, Lord High Artificer, Sphinx of the Steel Wind, and Bolas's Citadel ensures that the deck can close out the game once it has gained control.

The deck revolves around utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Archon of Cruelty and Serra's Emissary, while controlling the game with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. It also incorporates disruptive cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Wrenn and Six to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy to win the game efficiently and decisively.

The deck focuses on using hatebears and disruptive spells to slow down opponents while also applying pressure with aggro creatures. The mana base is optimized for fast starts and resource denial, utilizing cards like Ancient Tomb and Wasteland. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth make it difficult for opponents to cast spells efficiently, while cards like Archon of Emeria and Solitude provide both disruption and aggression. Karn, the Great Creator offers utility and additional hate. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plan while quickly closing out the game with efficient threats.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Coveted Jewel and using various artifacts and spells to accelerate mana production and draw cards. The key strategy is to quickly ramp up mana with artifacts like Mana Crypt and Grim Monolith, using Paradoxical Outcome to draw cards and potentially untap Coveted Jewel for additional mana. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Pact of Negation to protect the combo pieces. The goal is to establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with sheer card advantage and mana acceleration.

This deck focuses on using hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to disrupt opponents while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and White Plume Adventurer. The deck also utilizes powerful artifact ramp like Mana Crypt and Moxen to accelerate its game plan. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Chalice of the Void further enhances its disruption capabilities. The mana base is designed to maximize consistency and disruption with cards like Cavern of Souls and Wasteland.

The deck focuses on using the powerful card Doomsday to set up a winning combo with Thassa's Oracle. The deck runs various fast mana sources like Black Lotus and Dark Ritual to quickly assemble the combo and protect it with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The deck also includes powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to help find key pieces of the combo. Overall, the deck aims to set up and execute the Doomsday combo as quickly and efficiently as possible to win the game.

The focus of this deck is to quickly mill the opponent's entire library using Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, then win the game with Thassa's Oracle triggering its win condition due to the opponent having no cards left in their library. The deck includes various fast mana sources, protection spells such as Force of Will, and counterspells like Pact of Negation to ensure the combo goes off successfully in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format without relying on traditional lands.

This deck focuses on leveraging the power of Underworld Breach to cast multiple spells from the graveyard, generating a powerful combo engine. It includes cards that help control the board and disrupt opponents, as well as ways to dig for crucial pieces of the combo. By utilizing cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Dreadhorde Arcanist, it can consistently recur spells and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of key cards like Brain Freeze and Lotus Petal enable explosive plays that can quickly overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly milling through your library using Undercity Informer and Balustrade Spy to put Narcomoebas or Thassa's Oracle into play. Use cards like Dark Ritual and Chrome Mox to ramp into fast mana sources like Mox Sapphire and Black Lotus to power out your combo pieces. Force of Will and Pact of Negation protect your combo from disruption while Cabal Therapy and Grief help control your opponent's hand. Once you have enough cards in your graveyard, Dread Return can be used to reanimate key pieces like Oracle for the win.
